value.rationale: Exact limiting rank and update-order stability are motivated directly by the 2026 spectral weight decay method's low-rank and order claims. The new theorem establishes rank-flat nonzero attractors, sharp eta a=1 order transition, diverging fixed-step pre/post asymptotic amplitude ratio, positive regularized objective floor, and sharp contrast against actual proximal termination. These precise facts are needed to characterize when additive weight-polar shrinkage fails as a nuclear-norm optimization surrogate, beyond a routine one-step observation.
